name: verification-contract
description: Internal contract: the acceptance artifact per delivery unit — legacy (pre- feature 61) units may carry a frozen `ACCEPTANCE.md` (binding if present); post-feature 61 units use the unit doc's `## Acceptance criteria` section as the canonical acceptance source; the unit doc's evidence carrier — `## Evidence` table, or `## Log` `E` lines for a re-cut unit (#308) — serves as the execution receipt. Consumed by planners, execute-phase, and review-change.
